name: vitta-purchase-agent
description: Attempts the proposed purchase. Every merchant write goes through the Vitta gate, which reads the real cart and deterministically ALLOWs or DENYs; a denial stops the browser action and is returned verbatim.

skills.name: Purchase through the Vitta gate
skills.description: Build the cart and place the order, subject to the signed mandate. Idempotent per request id.
examples: Buy the proposed Zepto item under the current mandate
